The '''''Marauder''''' was an [[Ardent-class fast frigate|''Ardent''-class fast frigate]] serving as the [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] of the [[First Coruscant Task Force]], a detachment of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] loyal to the [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Sith Empire]]. It was commanded by the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Krion Grail]] and his second-in-command, [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Shantillen]].
